title: The Raise That Made Him Poorer

voiceProfile.narrator: Third-person close focus on Bhaskar Sen
voiceProfile.tense: Past tense with sharp numerical present-tense ledger moments

characters.name: Bhaskar Sen
characters.description: Director of Operations at an e-commerce firm in Gurgaon. Son of a Durgapur municipal engineer.
characters.internalConflict: Earns ₹31 lakhs a year—ten times his father's peak salary—yet experiences a paralyzing terror on the 28th of every month.

characters.name: Ruchira Sen
characters.description: Content director at a publishing house. Practical, overwhelmed by the social performance of Gurgaon gated societies.

characters.name: Neil
characters.description: Enrolled in an elite IB school with golf and robotics fees that cost more than a college semester.

motifs: The 2:00 AM credit card statement with twelve installments of 'No-Cost EMI'
The Golf Course Extension Road high-rise with gold-tinted double glazing
The second European SUV parked in basement slot B-22
The father's old steel HMT wristwatch ticking with mechanical modesty
The quiet rebellion of canceling the country club membership and eating street kachoris
